en.title: MACHINE VISION
en.desc: A visual investigation into how one scene changes when it is read by a human, a machine, memory and dream — using the gaps between those readings as the material of the project.
en.question: Can perception itself become an interface? Instead of treating AI vision as a neutral reading of an image, the project compares multiple ways of seeing and makes their disagreements visible.
en.built: A repeatable visual system that moves from ordinary source imagery into spatial structure, segmentation, fragments, probability and semantic transformation. The output is edited as a contact-sheet-like sequence rather than a single hero image.
en.judgement: The key decision was restraint. The images needed to stay recognisable enough to compare, but unresolved enough to make the viewer notice how each system edits reality. Too literal became illustration; too abstract lost the test.
taste: KEEP
Comparison visible at a glance; one visual grammar across different modes of perception.
REMOVE
Decorative AI texture that does not reveal anything about how the image is being interpreted.
TEST
How little information can remain before recognition collapses — and whether that threshold differs by mode.

zh.title: 机器视觉
zh.brief: 人类 × 机器 × 记忆
zh.role: 概念 / 视觉方向 / 原型
zh.tools: AI 模型 / 代码 / 图像
zh.desc: 一个关于“看见”本身的视觉研究：同一场景被人、机器、记忆与梦境读取时会发生怎样的偏移，而这些偏移本身就是作品材料。
zh.question: 感知本身能不能成为界面？这个项目不把 AI 视觉当成中性的识别工具，而是把不同观看方式之间的错位直接呈现出来。
zh.built: 我建立了一套可重复的视觉系统，把普通图像逐步转译成空间结构、分割、碎片、概率与语义变形。最终输出更像一张接触表，而不是单张英雄图。
zh.judgement: 最关键的判断是克制。图像必须保留足够可识别性，方便比较；同时又要保留不确定性，让观看者意识到每一种系统都在改写现实。太具象会变成插画，太抽象又失去测试意义。
media: 源图 → 机器 / 记忆 / 梦境
taste: 保留
一眼就能看出比较关系；不同感知模式共享同一套视觉语法。
去除
不能解释“如何被理解”的装饰性 AI 纹理。
测试
信息最少保留到什么程度时识别会崩塌，以及不同模式的阈值是否不同。

en.title: CITY AS DATA
en.desc: A spatial-data workflow and web interface that turns a complex Melbourne city model into something designers can browse, interrogate and use for storytelling.
en.question: City models are powerful but often trapped inside specialist software. How can the same information become legible to architects, project teams and clients without flattening the spatial complexity?
en.built: A workflow connecting spatial geometry, urban data and browser-based interaction. Project and city information is organised into a navigable web experience, with visualisation and dashboard logic used to surface useful patterns.
en.judgement: The interface only works when information density is controlled. I prioritised spatial orientation and progressive disclosure over showing every available dataset at once — turning technical depth into a sequence of understandable decisions.
taste: KEEP
Spatial context visible while data changes, so the user never loses where they are.
REMOVE
Dashboard elements that repeat information already obvious in the model.
TEST
Which data deserves to be persistent, and which should appear only at the moment it becomes useful.

zh.title: 城市即数据
zh.role: 设计 / 开发 / 数据
zh.desc: 一个将复杂墨尔本城市模型转化为可浏览、可分析、可叙事的空间数据工作流与网页界面。
zh.question: 城市模型很强大，但常常被困在专业软件里。怎样在不扁平化空间复杂度的前提下，让建筑师、项目团队与客户都能真正使用同一套信息？
zh.built: 我搭建了连接空间几何、城市数据与浏览器交互的工作流，把项目与城市信息组织成可导航的网页体验，并通过可视化与 dashboard 逻辑让模式更容易被看见。
zh.judgement: 这种界面只有在信息密度被控制住时才成立。我优先考虑空间定位感与渐进式信息展开，而不是一次性展示所有数据，把技术深度转化为容易理解的决策序列。
media: 交互地图 / 城市模型
taste: 保留
数据变化时仍保持空间上下文，让用户始终知道自己身在何处。
去除
重复模型中已显而易见信息的 dashboard 元素。
测试
哪些数据应该持续可见，哪些应该只在真正有用的时刻出现。

en.title: RHINO TABS
en.desc: An internal interface that brings studio standards, modelling tools, material libraries, city resources and Nearmap access into one coherent working surface.
en.question: A studio can have excellent digital resources and still make them hard to use. What happens if the problem is treated as interface design rather than documentation?
en.built: Rhino Tabs consolidates recurring resources and workflows into a shared tool. The system was shaped through conversations with designers from different backgrounds and iterated around actual friction in day-to-day work.
en.judgement: The value is not the number of features. It is whether the right action is obvious at the right moment. I reduced hierarchy, renamed ambiguous functions and grouped tools by user intent rather than by how they were technically implemented.
taste: KEEP
Actions described in the language designers already use in the studio.
REMOVE
Technical categories that expose implementation details but do not help the user decide.
TEST
Whether a first-time user can find a resource without being told where it lives.

zh.title: RHINO TABS
zh.brief: 把内部工具当成界面来设计
zh.meta: 产品 / UX / 设计系统
zh.role: 产品思考 / UX / 搭建
zh.tools: RHINO / 脚本 / UI 系统
zh.desc: 一个把工作室标准、建模工具、材质库、城市资源与 Nearmap 入口整合到同一工作界面中的内部工具。
zh.question: 一个工作室即使拥有很好的数字资源，也可能依然很难使用。如果把这个问题当成“界面设计”而不是“文档归档”来处理，会发生什么？
zh.built: Rhino Tabs 把高频资源与工作流整合成共享工具。系统通过与不同背景设计师的沟通逐步成型，并围绕真实工作摩擦点持续迭代。
zh.judgement: 价值不在于功能数量，而在于用户是否能在正确时刻看见正确动作。我压缩层级、重命名模糊功能，并按用户意图而非技术实现方式来组织工具。
taste: 保留
使用工作室设计师本来就在使用的语言来描述动作。
去除
暴露实现细节却不能帮助用户决策的技术分类。
测试
第一次使用的人能否在没有提示的情况下找到资源。

en.title: AI PROTOTYPING
en.tools: CLAUDE CODE / CODEX / HTML / CSS / JS
en.desc: A continuing practice of building interfaces with coding agents: using models for speed and range, then repeatedly editing the output until the interaction, typography and behaviour feel intentional.
en.question: Coding agents can produce a functioning interface very quickly. The harder question is: how do you stop at something coherent rather than something merely complete?
en.built: I use Claude Code, Codex and ChatGPT to generate, refactor and test interactive prototypes, then direct the next iteration through concrete visual and behavioural critique. The process moves between prompt, browser, code and judgement rather than treating one prompt as the product.
en.judgement: My role is the filter. I look for generic motion, accidental hierarchy, over-sensitive interaction and visual effects that distract from the idea. I keep the model’s speed, but remove the model’s tendency to over-design.
taste: KEEP
Interactions that explain the concept through behaviour rather than adding decoration.
REMOVE
Animation that exists because the model can make it, not because the interface needs it.
TEST
Whether the same idea still feels strong after effects, gradients and unnecessary copy are stripped away.

zh.title: AI 原型实践
zh.brief: 把 Agent 当作创意协作者
zh.role: 方向 / 提示 / 搭建 / 编辑
zh.tools: CLAUDE CODE / CODEX / HTML / CSS / JS
zh.desc: 持续用 coding agents 搭建界面：利用模型的速度与广度生成原型，再通过反复编辑，让交互、字体与行为真正变得有意图。
zh.question: Coding agent 很快就能生成一个“能运行”的界面。更难的问题是：怎样让它停在一个 coherent 的状态，而不是只是做完而已？
zh.built: 我用 Claude Code、Codex 与 ChatGPT 来生成、重构和测试交互原型，再用具体的视觉与行为批评来指导下一轮迭代。过程在 prompt、浏览器、代码与判断之间来回切换，而不是把一次 prompt 当成最终产品。
zh.judgement: 我的角色是过滤器。我会识别过于通用的动效、意外的层级、过度敏感的交互，以及会分散概念注意力的视觉效果。我保留模型的速度，但去掉模型“过度设计”的倾向。
taste: 保留
通过行为解释概念，而不是只增加装饰的交互。
去除
只是因为模型会做就被加上的动画，而不是界面真正需要的动画。
测试
在去掉特效、渐变和多余文案之后，这个想法是否依然成立。

en.title: SPATIAL SYSTEMS
en.desc: Computational systems that connect design intent, geometry, data and BIM — turning repeated modelling or analysis into reusable workflows rather than one-off scripts.
en.question: How can a computational workflow stay flexible enough for design exploration while becoming reliable enough for a wider team to use?
en.built: Parametric workflows for modelling, feasibility, data processing and Rhino–Revit coordination. The emphasis is on reusable logic and readable inputs, so the tool supports design decisions instead of becoming another specialist dependency.
en.judgement: A good computational tool exposes the decisions that matter and hides the complexity that does not. I treat parameter count, naming and failure states as design choices, not engineering clean-up.
taste: KEEP
A small number of parameters with visible consequences.
REMOVE
Controls that are technically possible but produce no meaningful design choice.
TEST
Whether another designer can understand the system without opening the script.

zh.title: 空间系统
zh.desc: 连接设计意图、几何、数据与 BIM 的计算系统——把重复建模或分析转化为可复用的工作流，而不是一次性脚本。
zh.question: 一个计算工作流怎样既能保留设计探索的弹性，又足够稳定到可以让更广泛的团队使用？
zh.built: 参数化工作流覆盖建模、可行性研究、数据处理以及 Rhino–Revit 协同。重点在于可复用逻辑与可读输入，让工具服务于设计判断，而不是变成新的专业依赖。
zh.judgement: 好的计算工具会暴露真正重要的决策，同时隐藏不必要的复杂度。我把参数数量、命名方式与失败状态都当成设计选择，而不是单纯的工程收尾。
taste: 保留
少量但后果清晰可见的参数。
去除
技术上存在但并不产生真实设计选择的控制项。
测试
另一个设计师能否在不打开脚本的情况下理解这个系统。

en.title: OBSERVATION
en.desc: Photography as an ongoing exercise in attention: people, buildings, incidental gestures and landscape fragments selected over the years, mostly in medium and 135 format film, with a small amount of digital work as supplement.
en.question: What makes an image worth keeping when nothing dramatic is happening? The section treats selection and sequencing as a way to make visual judgement explicit.
en.built: An evolving body of street, architectural, landscape and observational photography. The work moves slowly through contact sheets and sequences, and the edit is treated as part of the image-making.
en.judgement: I look for tension between geometry and behaviour, clarity without over-composition, and frames that gain more meaning when they sit beside another frame. The edit matters as much as the shutter.
taste: KEEP
Images with one clear visual reason to exist, even when the subject is ordinary.
REMOVE
Technically clean photographs that say the same thing as a stronger frame.
TEST
Whether a sequence produces a new reading that no single image can carry alone.

zh.title: 观察
zh.brief: 摄影 / 年份 / 碎片
zh.meta: 中画幅 / 135 胶片 / 数码补充
zh.tools: 相机 / 序列 / 编辑
zh.desc: 把摄影当作一种持续的注意力练习：人物、建筑、偶然动作与风景碎片，跨越不同年份拍摄，主要以中画幅与 135 胶片为主，少量数码作为补充。
zh.question: 当没有明显戏剧事件发生时，什么样的图像仍然值得被保留？这个部分把“挑选”与“排序”当成显化视觉判断的方法。
zh.built: 一个持续生长的街头、建筑、风景与观察性影像集合。作品通过接触表和序列慢慢成形，编辑本身被视为拍摄的一部分。
zh.judgement: 我在意几何与行为之间的张力、清晰但不过度构图的画面，以及一张图像与另一张图像并置后产生的新含义。快门和编辑同样重要。
media: 序列 / 编辑 / 节奏
taste: 保留
即使主题平常，也有明确视觉理由存在的图像。
去除
技术上很干净、但表达重复于更强画面的照片。
测试
一个序列是否能产生单张图像无法承担的新阅读。
